描述_ZN: The scroll of "Kung reads Hanlin courtyard aphorisms", Ming, inscribed by Dong Qichang, in regular script on paper, 128 cm long and 53 cm wide.　　Signed: "Written by Dong Qichang." Inscribed under the paragraph with "Qing Gong Tai Bao" and "Dong Qichang Seal". The leading seal is "Xuanhuizhai". The seal of connoisseurship is inscribed as "Lu Shihua, Yunzhi", "Weinan Bo Hou", and "Fan Zhong Zhi Yin", etc.　　This is Dong Qichang's calligraphy of "Emperor Xuanzong (Zhu Zhanji) Imperial Hanlin Academy Provisions" in the middle regular script, which is known to be his work in his later years according to the mark. The spacing between the lines is quite sparse, making it appear sparse and elegant. The calligraphic style is simple and clumsy, intentionally avoiding strict and neat work and stability, in order to take the meaning of the clumsy, so to speak. Dong once said of himself, "My calligraphy is beautiful because of its birth." His artistic vision and calligraphic characteristics are evident in this work.　　Dong's calligraphy was once collected by Lu Shihua and others in the Qing Dynasty.
